studies.title: 风场 · 飘旗与草浪
studies.text: 同向阵风带动蓝旗、大片藏身草丛和贴地雪粉，挂灯轻摆；动静对比来自固定石墙与柔软材质。
studies.focus: A visible gust moves through this frozen bridge shoulder. Two restrained blue cloth banners with pale snowflake motifs are caught mid-flutter, attached firmly to horizontal wall brackets; show clear curling fabric silhouettes and loose frayed hems. One LARGE continuous dense concealment brush bed along the wall leans in a readable rolling wave, with fixed roots and coherent footprint, not scattered little tufts. A hanging amber lantern tilts slightly on its hook. Fine snow powder lifts off a wall cap and sweeps as a few thin low wisps parallel to the road. All wind-driven objects agree on the gust direction. Clear frozen masonry stays immobile; broad road remains sharply visible. Convey motion with fabric folds, leaning stalks and separated powder specks, no speed lines or blurred rendering.

studies.title: 冷暖 · 飞烬与融雪滴水
studies.text: 小火盆的偏转火舌、上升飞烬和薄烟，配合受热冰挂滴水及浅水涟漪，形成近景的细小连续运动。
studies.focus: An intimate scene of one modest low carved stone brazier burning beside the straight wall. Show lively amber flame tongues bending in a light breeze, a handful of glowing embers carried upward and sideways, and a delicate curling thread of smoke. Small warm reflected highlights on adjacent wet stones and wall. The short icicles immediately above the warm zone visibly thaw: one distinct falling droplet beneath an icicle tip, tiny splash and fine concentric ripples in a shallow meltwater patch at the wall foot. Snow and ice remain on colder parts. Fire occupies only a small local area, no big bonfire or thick smoke, no flooding across the road. Convey tiny living motion through articulated flame shapes, embers, water droplets and ripples; no exaggerated magical aura.

studies.title: 纵深 · 流雾与掠翼
studies.text: 桥外分层雾带、远处未冻瀑流和少量飞鸟，给固定桥体提供远景运动与深度；战斗面保持清楚。
studies.focus: A wider environmental view of the existing central bridge suspended over its icy abyss. Preserve intact straight parallel parapets and the broad open stone bridge deck, no broken wall, new corner or side platform. Most motion belongs OUTSIDE the playable bridge: low wispy mist ribbons drift between dark distant rock spires, at two different depth scales, revealing silhouettes rather than hiding everything. A distant partially frozen waterfall has a narrow visible falling-water ribbon between heavy ice sheets, with soft spray at its far-away foot. Three small dark ravens in distinct natural wing poses bank across the canyon BELOW and behind the parapet line; birds remain tiny scenery accents, not foreground monsters. Thin sparse snow flurries over the far canyon and a little wind-lifted powder on the bridge edge. Keep the stone combat paving cleanly readable. Emphasize atmospheric depth and quiet continuous motion, no storm whiteout, no fantasy vortex or huge foreground bird.

studies.title: 生机 · 水晶微光与魄罗
studies.text: 圣所水晶内部流光、稀疏上升微粒与小魄罗的跳跃、呼气，为出生区加入轻松的生命感。
studies.focus: A living sanctuary detail scene built around the existing blue crystal altar, with snowy stone paving, old guardians and modest warm fire bowls in the established art direction. Main crystal remains rooted and solid; inside its translucent facets a soft thin blue energy current rises, a few faint motes lift near its base and restrained pale light reflects onto adjacent stone. No floating rocks or giant magic ring, no explosive neon glow. Add exactly two SMALL fluffy white poros with curved brown horns, stubby feet and pink tongues at the safe outer shoulder, scaled far smaller than the altar: one caught in a playful low hop with tiny feet lifted and a small separated contact shadow; the other leaning forward curiously to sniff snow with a faint little puff of visible breath. Tiny footprints near them. Leave the main spawn travel route open. They supply charming environmental life without becoming hero-scale subjects. Subtle wind in an existing hanging banner. Capture a believable moment of motion, no motion blur, no UI or labels.
